The '''Colonies region Dejarik tournament''' was held in [[Great ReSynchronization|13:4]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kanti]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. Eight players of the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] game [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] reached the quarterfinals, in which reigning [[Sector/Legends|sector]] champion [[Ohh Bronna]] took offense to a move by [[Gender/Legends|his]] opponent, [[Corwin Kaezeb]]. Bronna upset the [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] and physically attacked Kaezeb, creating a distraction that the [[Unidentified dejarik player (losing quarterfinal 1)|losing]] [[Unidentified dejarik player (losing quarterfinal 2)|players]] in two other quarterfinal matches took advantage of to reset their boards. With no rules in place to handle the situation, [[D'nisenz]], who won the remaining quarterfinal match, was declared the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region champion.

==The tournament==
{{Quote|It was a fair move. Getting upset about it obviously didn't help. Though I must admit, it felt good to do my own fighting for a change.|Corwin Kaezeb|<ref name="HNN" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] played host to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] tournament. Held in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kanti]] in [[Great ReSynchronization|13:4]], the tournament featured players of the [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] game known as dejarik fighting it out for the title of champion of the Colonies region. The quarterfinal round of the tournament consisted of eight players competing in four head-to-head matches, one of which featured reigning [[Sector/Legends|sector]] champion [[Ohh Bronna]] against [[yonta]]-level player [[Corwin Kaezeb]]. Well into the Bronna&ndash;Kaezeb game, Bronna appeared to have a significant lead until Kaezeb entered a move that resulted in [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Ng'ok/Legends|ng'ok]] [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] running across the board, springing off the [[Houjix/Legends|houjix]], and landing a leaping kick to Bronna's [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|savrip's]] head. After remaining silent for a moment, Bronna knocked the [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] down onto the ground and launched a physical attack against his opponent, jumping onto Kaezeb's shoulders and proceeding to beat him in the head, drawing blood.<ref name="HNN" />

In the meantime, the distraction caused by the fight served as sufficient cover for two [[Unidentified dejarik player (losing quarterfinal 1)|other]] [[Unidentified dejarik player (losing quarterfinal 2)|players]] in two of the other quarterfinal games to reset their own holotables, erasing [[Unidentified dejarik player (leading quarterfinal 1)|their]] [[Unidentified dejarik player (leading quarterfinal 2)|opponents']] leads. This led to angry responses and ultimately resulted in an all-out brawl among all six players. The brawl was eventually broken up and although Bronna was restrained, he remained livid as he commented to a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reporter that Kaezeb's move was below even a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and accused his opponent of rigging the game table. Kaezeb, on the other hand, asserted that the move was fair and observed that Bronna's anger solved nothing, though he enjoyed the chance to do his own fighting for once.<ref name="HNN" />

The final quarterfinal match, which pitted [[Garem Will]] against [[D'nisenz]], was unaffected by the melee, as the two players were so engrossed in the game that they failed to notice anything amiss until they had completed their own game, which was won by D'nisenz. The tournament lacked sufficient established rules and procedures to address the actions of Bronna and the two players who had reset their tables, which collectively caused all but the Will&ndash;D'nisenz match to be ruined. As such, D'nisenz, the sole player to win in the quarterfinals, was declared the Colonies region champion by default. Later, on 13:4:11, the HoloNet News published an article detailing the events of the quarterfinal round and its aftermath.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Colonies region Dejarik tournament of 22 BBY was featured in a [[2002]] article on the [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News (original website)|''HoloNet News'']] website.<ref name="HNN" /> To date, the tournament has not been mentioned in any other ''[[Star Wars]]'' media.
